title: Samsung Electronics, SK hynix Consider First Packaging Plants in Honam - thelec.net
snippet: Samsung Electronics, SK hynix Consider First Packaging Plants in Honam  thelec.net

triage.summary: Samsung Electronics and SK hynix are considering establishing their first semiconductor packaging plants in South Korea's Honam region. This is exploratory discussion of a potential capacity expansion that could support memory production, but no concrete decision, timeline, or investment commitment has been announced yet.
